# Aarya Plastopet

> Aarya Plastopet is a manufacturer and exporter of LLDPE stretch film and REINLAND silage wrap film, based at the Machenahalli Production Unit, Bhadravathi, Shimoga district, Karnataka, India. It sells to businesses and farmers across India (with GST invoices) and exports full container loads (FOB / CIF).

Prices are not published because they depend on size, quantity and delivery location; buyers request a quote.

- Sales WhatsApp / phone: +91 74836 43028
- Email: info@aaryaplastopet.com
- Factory: Machenahalli Industrial Area, 1st Cross, Bhadravathi, Shimoga, Karnataka, India

## Products

- [Stretch film for India](https://www.aaryaplastopet.com/india/stretch-film.html): hand and machine grade LLDPE pallet wrap. Hand grade 300, 350, 450, 500 mm; machine grade 500, 600 mm; 12–35 µm; roll length 200–3,600 m. Virgin LLDPE, GST invoice, delivery across Karnataka and South India.
- [Stretch film for export](https://www.aaryaplastopet.com/export/stretch-film.html): same range plus custom 12–50 µm, core sizes and roll lengths; palletised for 20 ft and 40 ft containers; FOB or CIF; labelling and export documents.
- [REINLAND silage wrap for India](https://www.aaryaplastopet.com/india/silage-film.html): UV-stabilised bale wrap for dairy farms and bale makers. REINLAND-60 (250–750 mm, 20–25 µm, 1,500–1,800 m, 10–12 months UV) and REINLAND-400 (500–750 mm, 20 µm, 18 months UV). Dealers supplied direct.
- [REINLAND silage wrap for export](https://www.aaryaplastopet.com/export/silage-film.html): co-extruded silage wrap, 500 and 750 mm export widths, private label / OEM available, full container loads to distributors and co-operatives.
- [REINLAND 22 µ](https://www.aaryaplastopet.com/22-micron/): thinner REINLAND silage wrap that wraps more bales per roll, with a saving calculator.
